entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/140-identity-ast-stale-on-reload.md
entries.description: `IdentityConfigStore.reload_if_stale` (`src/daemon/config_layer.py`) treats **config file mtime** as the freshness signal, then loads Telos/Constraints via `_load_from_graph()` → `get_graph_ast_cache(graph_root).get_graph()`.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/141-routing-hint-enum.md
entries.description: `src/agent/routing_hint.py` emits L1/L2 routing markers as **magic strings** in HTML comments:

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/142-semantic-config-injection.md
entries.description: `src/semantic/config.py` already centralizes embedding env resolution (`EmbeddingSettings`, `HybridWeights`, `dual_embedding_enabled()`).

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/143-graph-analytics-catalog-load-log.md
entries.description: `_count_catalog_summaries` in `src/graph/graph_analytics.py` (~L118–124) wraps `load_master_catalog(root)` in bare `except Exception` and returns `0` with **no log line**.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/144-checkpoint-bak-restore-copy-log.md
entries.description: `read_daemon_checkpoint` in `src/daemon/checkpoint.py` (~L64–66) recovers from a corrupt primary checkpoint by reading `.matryca_daemon_state.json.bak`, then restores the primary file via `shutil.copy2(bak_path, path)` inside `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/145-daemon-state-bak-restore-copy-log.md
entries.description: `load_daemon_state` in `src/agent/maintenance_daemon.py` (~L793–795) mirrors checkpoint recovery: when the primary `.matryca_daemon_state.json` is unreadable, it loads from `.bak` and attempts `shutil.copy2(bak_path, path)` inside `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/146-daemon-state-bak-write-log.md
entries.description: `save_daemon_state` in `src/agent/maintenance_daemon.py` (~L830–832) atomically writes the primary daemon state, then copies it to `.matryca_daemon_state.json.bak` inside `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/147-journey-log-upsert-log.md
entries.description: `_finalize_link_and_journey_pass` in `src/agent/maintenance_daemon.py` (~L2884–2891) wraps `upsert_journey_log(...)` in `contextlib.suppress(OSError)` when journey logging is enabled and the cycle has journal activity.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/148-watcher-deleted-link-registry-log.md
entries.description: `_on_watchdog_change` in `src/agent/maintenance_daemon.py` (~L2117–2119) calls `register_page_links_from_path` when the file watcher reports a **deleted** `.md` page and link verification is enabled.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/149-phase2-lint-link-registry-log.md
entries.description: During Phase-2 cognitive lint in `run_cycle` (`src/agent/maintenance_daemon.py`, ~L2636–2638), `merge_page_links_into_registry` runs inside `contextlib.suppress(OSError)` before `run_cognitive_lint_pipeline`.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/150-phase2-end-cycle-totals-log.md
entries.description: At **cycle start**, `run_cycle` already logs `refresh_phase2_cognitive_totals` failures (`logger.warning`, ~L2919–2922).

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/151-fast-track-link-registry-log.md
entries.description: In `run_cycle`, fast-track skippable files call `register_page_links_from_path` when link verification is enabled (`src/agent/maintenance_daemon.py`, ~L2962–2964).

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/152-plumber-config-env-int-warning.md
entries.description: `_env_int` in `src/agent/plumber_config.py` (~L58–65) returns the Python default when `int(raw)` raises `ValueError`, with **no warning**.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/153-occ-mtime-ns-parity.md
entries.description: Page-level OCC in `src/graph/markdown_blocks.py` snapshots and compares `st_mtime` as a `float` (`read_file_mtime`, `file_mtime_drifted`).

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/154-tana-slim-nodedump-payloads.md
entries.description: Tana import streams JSON via `ijson` (no `json.load()` DOM).

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/155-generational-cache-sig-tou.md
entries.description: `get_cached_bm25_corpus` and `cached_build_alias_index` in `src/graph/generational_cache.py` build the corpus/index, then capture `_signature(...)` **after** the build (`sig_after`), and store `(sig_after, artifact)`.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/156-tana-id-stream-scan.md
entries.description: `scan_existing_tana_ids` in `src/agent/importers/tana/write.py` calls `read_graph_file_text` for every scannable page/journal, materializing full page bodies in RAM to regex-scan `tana-id::` values.

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/157-lock-registry-acquire-hardening.md
entries.description: `page_write_lock._lock_for_key` evicts LRU registry entries when `not old_lock.locked()` before allocating a new `RLock` for a path (`_MAX_PAGE_LOCK_REGISTRY = 4096`).

entries.title: docs/quality/issue-bodies/158-link-verification-env-parse.md
